head_commit.message:
[harvest] Record a same-pair start mismatch in the HLTV attempt evidence

The dated view was read successfully on the last refresh (63 fixtures) and still
produced no exact match for benched gods vs TitanFlow at 2026-10-22T11:00:00Z,
while the probe that runs minutes later is rate-limited by HLTV and cannot see
the list at all. The refresh now records the same opponent pair when HLTV lists
it at a different UTC start, so the reason is published instead of guessed. The
near miss is evidence only: an assumed start correction is still refused.

head_commit.message:
[harvest] Dump what HLTV discovery actually sees for the one unpicked fixture

The post-fix harvest (snapshot 2026-10-21T20:30:11Z) prices 1082858 Ground Zero
vs Off Chops at 39.83%/60.17% from the registered rename, so the gap list is now
three rows. 1081597 benched gods vs TitanFlow still has no pick: the dated HLTV
view was read (63 fixtures, 0 new candidates) and nothing matched the exact pair
at 2026-10-22T11:00:00Z. The probe now records the collector's own parsed
candidate list - every candidate sharing a team label with a gap row, and every
candidate at that exact UTC start - so the reason is measured, not assumed.

Co-authored-by: arena-agent <297053741+arena-agent@users.noreply.github.com>
